verdict.rationale: A public status page with historical incident postmortems is a fair question for a hosted serverless platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a status page, incident history, or postmortems. The 'built-in observability' and Observability MCP items cover monitoring of the customer's own Workers, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can check a public status page with historical incident postmortems before committing
